Her dark black-brown straight chin-length bob has straight forehead bangs and small tied side sections. Exactly one pink bow stays on her anatomical RIGHT, viewer LEFT in frontal views; never mirror it. She wears rose-pink long-sleeve two-piece pajamas with exactly one centered white heart on the FRONT chest, matching rose-pink loose trousers with ribbed cuffs and pale-pink socks. No added shoes, hat, glasses, jewelry, markings or logos. Preserve her approved face geometry, eyes, cheeks, age, hair and proportions; expressions and speech phonemes may change only for acting.
Mom-Alice is a human stylized 3D adult woman about thirty years old, about twice Alice's standing height, slender natural adult proportions, softly rounded oval face, warm light-peach skin with subtle freckles, warm brown eyes with near-black pupils and white catchlights, softly arched chestnut eyebrows, delicate lashes, small rounded nose, natural pink lips, rounded ears and chin. Her chestnut shoulder-length hair has soft waves, a side part and gently swept front hair. She wears a plain dusty-teal short-sleeve crewneck top, cream straight tailored trousers and off-white low flat shoes. No bow, hat, glasses, jewelry or extra accessories. Preserve the canonical face geometry, eye spacing, nose, lips, skin, freckles, age and hairstyle; only expression, gaze, blinking and speech phonemes may change for acting.
The Dutch milkmaid is a DISTINCT ADULT human dairy worker about thirty-five years old, visibly adult in face and full-height natural proportions, with fair lightly freckled skin, blue-gray eyes, a relaxed oval face, a practical long blonde braid and a small plain white cotton work cap. She wears a modest sky-blue work dress over a white long-sleeve cotton blouse, a plain white full apron and dark practical farm boots. No logos, brand marks, text or jewelry. Her face, blonde hair, dress and adult proportions must remain separate from Mother and Alice. She works calmly seated on a low stable milking stool beside Cow A at the farm-side station. Her lips stay gently touching at all times; she never speaks, sings, mouths the family dialogue or smiles with an open mouth. Preserve the user-selected milkmaid identity, blonde braid, white cap, blue work dress and adult proportions from the supplied selected anchor.
An entirely OUTDOOR cottage garden beside a dairy pasture in soft warm morning daylight. A low oval wooden picnic table stands on a dry woven garden mat with two floor cushions; a shaded wooden garden bench sits beneath a leafy tree. Flower borders, green grass and a small distant red barn establish the farm. A continuous sturdy wooden fence separates the garden from the pasture and the sheltered farm-side milking station. Mother and Alice always remain on the garden side, several steps from the fence; they never reach through or enter the cow enclosure. Exactly TWO calm adult black-and-white dairy cows inhabit the farm: Cow A, with a broad black shoulder patch and white forehead, stands quietly side-on at the sheltered station; Cow B, with a black patch around its right eye, grazes farther back in the pasture. Keep their markings, adult scale and count consistent. At least one cow remains clearly visible in every shot. The adult Dutch milkmaid sits beside Cow A under the open-sided timber shelter, hand-milking gently into one stable metal pail beneath the udder. Her two hands use a plausible alternating squeeze-and-release action; brief thin milk streams enter the pail. The cows never speak or enter the garden. The milking pail and its fresh raw contents remain entirely on the farm side. The family's sealed ready-to-drink milk bottle came separately from the picnic basket and stays on the garden table; never show cow milk transferred straight to Alice, her cup or that sealed bottle.
Outdoor medium-wide establishing two-shot at the picnic table. Mother sits on the shaded garden bench at screen right; Alice kneels safely on a floor cushion at screen left on the woven mat. Beyond the continuous fence, clearly establish the silent adult Dutch milkmaid seated beside Cow A under the open-sided timber shelter with a metal pail beneath the cow, while Cow B grazes farther back. The family stays several steps from the fence. No pouring or drinking-glass lift.

Keep raw milk on the farm side and the sealed lesson bottle separate. Current-shot human framing: three clearly visible.
STAGING LOCK: Outdoor garden and dairy pasture. Mother is seated at screen right and is the only speaker. Alice kneels on the cushion at screen left and listens with a closed mouth. The adult Dutch milkmaid works silently in the background beside Cow A, with Cow B farther back. Both cows remain behind the continuous enclosure fence. Preserve the approved sealed bottle, table, bench, mat, shelter, pail, animal count, framing and character identities. No pouring, drinking, enclosure entry, camera cut or second speaker. Mother may gently rotate the sealed bottle in place while speaking. Alice blinks and reacts only with closed lips.
